content: playbackRate clamping: Chrome/Firefox clamp effective rate to 0.0625-16.0; audio MUTES outside 0.5-4.0 (Chrome) / 0.25-4.0 (Firefox) (MDN + SO + Chromium/Gecko source). Safari is the outlier: max 2.0 on macOS and iOS (danieljwilson.me testing table; Apple's archived docs said playbackRate unsupported on iOS, later versions honor up to 2.0; caniuse lists support 3.1+). Consequence: any SlowGram degradation using playbackRate >2.0 silently does nothing on iOS; >4.0 mutes audio (volume lever becomes irrelevant); use defaultPlaybackRate too since playbackRate resets on media change/ended in some browsers. Keep rates within 0.5-2.0 for cross-platform consistency.
